en: A colorized winter scene shows a long two‑story inn covered in snow with skiers and people gathered outside. The main gabled end of the building has large German lettering identifying it as an inn. Fences border the snowy foreground, and bare trees and more snow-covered landscape are visible in the background. Printed text in the upper right corner indicates the place name and country.
